name: thomas-pubgolf-ios
description: Native iPhone shell for Thomas' Pub Golf

scripts.ios:init: npm run build:web && node scripts/ensure-ios.mjs && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
